speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation. Since you are a newborn, I will need to ask your parent a few questions about your health. To begin, how old are you in days, and have you been feeding well since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. Given the mother's lack of prenatal care and the newborn's presentation of specific physical findings such as a snuffles, maculopapular rash, and desquamation, along with the absence of immunization records, this is highly indicative of congenital syphilis. REQUEST TEST: RPR (Rapid Plasma Reagin) and VDRL (Venereal Disease Research Laboratory) for the newborn and mother. REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin exam.
